title: Industrial Engineering Management
description:
Studied the principles of engineering management, focusing on planning, organizing, coordinating, and controlling engineering and operational activities.

Key Topics Covered:

Management Fundamentals: Understanding the core functions of planning, organizing, leading, and controlling.

Engineering Decision-Making: Evaluating alternatives and making decisions based on operational objectives and constraints.

Resource Management: Understanding the allocation and coordination of people, equipment, time, and other organizational resources.

Organizational Structure: Exploring management responsibilities, organizational relationships, and coordination between departments.

Performance Management: Understanding how operational objectives and performance indicators support management decisions.

Leadership and Communication: Exploring the importance of teamwork, communication, and leadership in engineering organizations.

Knowledge Gained:

Developed an understanding of how management principles support engineering operations, organizational effectiveness, resource coordination, and structured decision-making.
